paper_id: Liu et al. - 2015 - Scan without a Glance Towards Content-Free Crowd-Sourced Mobile Video Retrieval System
title: Scan Without a Glance: Towards Content-Free Crowd-Sourced Mobile Video Retrieval System
motivation: Mobile video retrieval hindered by costly video transmission and CV computation; need to filter unmatched videos before content analysis
problem_framing: Video retrieval as spatio-temporal filtering: query Q=(ts,te,p,r) finds videos covering area(p,r) during time interval [ts,te]
key_insight: FoV (GPS+azimuth) as content-free descriptor with negligible size; motion = rotation + translation gives Sim = Sim_R × Sim_T
method_signature: FoV similarity measurement → real-time segmentation → R-Tree indexing → rank-based retrieval
evaluation_criteria: Feature extraction speed (orders of magnitude faster), search accuracy comparable to CV, response time <100ms, traffic reduction
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Intersection-based MBR retrieval insufficient; must filter by orientation (camera direction matters even at same location)
evidence_for_taste: negligible data size and low dimension
at least three orders of magnitude faster
no constraint on device subscribers' movements
thinking_moves: 把 perception 问题重新 frame 成 spatio-temporal communication 问题
用物理模型(旋转+平移)简化几何计算
分段阈值由经验决定而非理论最优
R-Tree 处理时间敏感 FoV 索引
